svg.title: One kernel under the four schedule policies
svg.desc: Four timelines of one kernel on the drive lines of D1, D2 and D3: an X pulse on D1, one on D2 and two on D3, then a sync of the three lines. asap: D1 at 0 ns, D2 at 0 ns, D3 at 0 and 40 ns, done at 80 ns; alap: D1 at 40 ns, D2 at 40 ns, D3 at 0 and 40 ns, done at 80 ns; rcp: D1 at 0 ns, D2 at 0 ns, D3 at 40 and 80 ns, done at 120 ns; alap_rcp: D1 at 0 ns, D2 at 40 ns, D3 at 40 and 80 ns, done at 120 ns. asap and alap drive 3 lines at once; rcp and alap_rcp never more than 2. Each pulse's Q quadrature is drawn dashed where it is large enough.
